name: iFixit
description: Free, community-written repair guides for phones, laptops and other electronics, plus repair parts and tools and a community forum.

name: Samsung India - Find a Service Center
description: Samsung India's official locator: choose a product category (e.g. mobile phone, TV, home appliance), enter a city, town or postcode and a search radius to find the nearest service centre.

name: Apple Support - Repair (India)
description: Apple's repair options for iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch and AirPods, with links to Apple Stores and Apple Authorised Service Providers and a way to check warranty or AppleCare coverage.

name: Karo Sambhav - E-Waste Collection Centres
description: Producer responsibility organisation listing e-waste collection centres in several states; accepts items such as laptops, printers and mobile phones.

name: Samsung India - E-Waste Take-back and Recycling
description: Samsung India's programme to recycle old products via authorised recyclers; pick-up can be requested by WhatsApp.

name: vivo India - E-Waste Take-back
description: vivo India's e-waste page: it works with CPCB-authorised PRO Karo Sambhav, and individual consumers can drop e-waste at its collection points.

name: Apple India - Recycling
description: Apple's India recycling page: devices you no longer use can be recycled, with links to the Apple Trade In and recycling programme pages.

name: CPCB - E-Waste Management
description: India's Central Pollution Control Board e-waste section: E-Waste (Management) Rules, notices on EPR authorisation, FAQs and technical guidelines; it does not list recyclers for households.

name: Apple Trade In (India)
description: Get credit toward a new Apple device for an eligible old one, online (iPhone) or in an Apple Store; Mac, iPad and Apple Watch in store.

name: Samsung India - Exchange (Upgrade) Program
description: Terms of Samsung India's exchange program: trade an old phone toward a new Samsung device, with buyback by partner Cashify.

name: Cashify
description: Indian platform to sell used phones, laptops, tablets, smartwatches and other gadgets; also sells refurbished devices and lists repair and phone recycling options.

name: Google - Reset your Android device to factory settings
description: Android Help guide to backing up data and factory resetting an Android phone, including what you need (Google Account, screen lock) and how to reset if Settings won't open.

name: Apple - Before you sell, give away or trade in your iPhone or iPad
description: Apple Support steps to transfer data, unpair Apple Watch, sign out of accounts and use Erase All Content and Settings; also covers eSIM and Android trade-ins.

name: Apple - How to factory reset your iPhone, iPad or iPod touch
description: Apple Support guide to erasing an iPhone, iPad or iPod touch via Settings, including backup, eSIM options and verification steps.

name: Apple - Erase your Mac and reset it to factory settings
description: Apple Support guide to erasing a Mac with Erase All Content and Settings, with steps for older macOS versions and Macs without that feature.

name: Microsoft - Reset your PC
description: Microsoft Support guide to resetting a Windows 10 or 11 PC, with 'Keep my files' or 'Remove everything' options; advises backing up and having your BitLocker recovery key ready.

name: Digital Empowerment Foundation - MeraByte device donation
description: DEF collects old but functional mobile phones, tablets, laptops, pen drives, cameras and other digital devices from individuals for rural communities.
